title: Venezuelan Roasted Beet Tagine
description: A traditional Venezuelan-inspired tagine recipe roasted to perfection in the oven. This sweet and earthy dish showcases the flavors of roasted beets and is perfect for a delicious and healthy meal. Simply serve with crusty bread or over rice for a satisfying dinner.

ingredients.name: beets
ingredients.notes: any color, but red beets add a deeper color

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality oil for best flavor

ingredients.name: cumin
ingredients.notes: ground cumin adds a warm, earthy flavor

ingredients.name: coriander
ingredients.notes: ground coriander adds a citrusy note

ingredients.name: paprika
ingredients.notes: smoked paprika adds a smoky depth

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use kosher salt for a flaky texture

instructions: Peel the beets and chop them into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Add the beet cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the beet mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Roast in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue roasting for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the beets are tender and caramelized.
Serve the roasted beets hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
